title: CM Vijay Wins Tamil Nadu Floor Test With 144 Votes, Cements Power
excerpt: The actor-turned-politician proved his majority after a dramatic AIADMK split, Supreme Court intervention, and backroom coalition-building
body:
Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay cleared his first major political hurdle on May 13, winning the assembly floor test with 144 votes in favor and just 22 against — a commanding margin that silences, for now, questions about the stability of his young government.

The vote capped a week of high political drama. Vijay, who swept to power through his Tamilaga Vetri Kazhagam (TVK) party after a stunning electoral debut, faced a confidence motion ordered by Governor R.V. Arlekar amid opposition demands. TVK won 108 seats in the election but needed 118 for a simple majority in the 234-member assembly.

**The Coalition Gambit:** Vijay bridged the gap through a coalition that now includes Congress, the Indian Union Muslim League (IUML), Viduthalai Chiruthaigal Katchi (VCK), CPI, and CPM — giving his bloc around 121 seats. But the decisive boost came from a dramatic split within the AIADMK, where a rebel faction led by former ministers S.P. Velumani and C.V. Shanmugam broke with party leader Edappadi K. Palaniswami to back the TVK government.

**Supreme Court Steps In:** Hours before the vote, the Supreme Court stayed a Madras High Court order that had barred TVK MLA R. Seenivasa Sethupathi from participating, removing a potential obstacle. The legal maneuvering underscored how tightly contested the numbers were until the final hours.

**The DMK Collapse:** The floor test marks a generational shift in Tamil Nadu politics. The DMK, which had governed since 2021 under M.K. Stalin, was routed in elections by a wave of anti-incumbency and Vijay's personal popularity as one of Tamil cinema's biggest stars. His party's rise from zero to government in a single election cycle is without precedent in modern Indian politics.

**The Diaspora View:** Tamil Nadu's politics resonate deeply with the roughly 300,000 Tamil-Americans in the United States and the broader Tamil diaspora worldwide. Vijay's transition from superstar to chief minister has captivated Tamil communities abroad, many of whom followed the floor test live. The AIADMK split also reshuffles the political landscape that diaspora organizations have navigated for decades when advocating for Tamil heritage and development issues.

**What to Watch:** With the floor test behind him, Vijay must now deliver on campaign promises of TASMAC liquor shop closures, education reform, and anti-corruption measures. The AIADMK split could trigger defection proceedings, and the DMK will likely challenge the rebel faction's legitimacy.
nri_angle: Tamil-Americans and the global Tamil diaspora closely followed the floor test, with Vijay's unprecedented rise from cinema icon to chief minister captivating Tamil communities abroad.
author: Diaspora Desk
